items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the general business law, in relation to requiring appearance enhancement business owners to provide masks and gloves to nail specialists
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S4747

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the general business law, in
relation to requiring appearance enhancement business owners to
provide masks and gloves to nail specialists

 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL : This bill requires nail salon
owners to provide protective masks and gloves to their employees. It
also gives employees the right to wear such protection if they so
choose.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :  Section one amends section 400 of
the general business law by adding two new subdivisions 11 and 12.
These subdivisions define "owner" and "area renter" for the purposes
of the bill.

Section two amends the general business law by adding section 405-a.
This section stipulates that owners of appearance enhancement
businesses are responsible for providing protective equipment to
employees. It also decrees that employees shall be allowed to wear
such protective equipment if they so choose.

Section three sets out the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :  In many nail salons, employees would like to use
protective equipment such as gloves and masks while they work.
However, many owners forbid or discourage their workers from doing
this as it could potentially scare away customers. This can have
detrimental effects on the health and safety of workers. Requiring
owners to not only provide protective equipment but also mandate that
they allow their workers to wear it if they so choose will help to
protect nail salon workers who spend many hours a day in rooms filled
with toxic fumes, chemicals and particulate matter.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY : New bill

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS : None

 EFFECTIVE DATE : Immediately
